order_placement_charges_fee.meaning: a fee is charged for submitting an order to the book

fees_applied_only_on_match.meaning: trading fees are applied only when orders are actually matched and executed

expiring_orders_removed_with_full_refund.meaning: expired orders are removed from the book with a full refund to the maker without fees

legit_market_maker_trading_cost_increase.meaning: trading costs for legitimate market makers relying on POST_ONLY orders are significantly impacted (potential)
legit_market_maker_trading_cost_increase.checkpoint: after attacker places short-expiry orders and victim is forced to taker execution

assumptions: Legitimate market makers rely on POST_ONLY orders to ensure maker status and the lower maker fee.
The attacker's short-expiry orders are placed at competitive prices around the spot price and are removed shortly after placement.
Victims' POST_ONLY orders are rejected by the POST_ONLY validation while expiring orders set the best bid/ask, forcing taker execution.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker's expiring orders are POST_ONLY or another order type, nor the exact ordering of refund versus victim POST_ONLY attempt.

The selected impact is potential and qualitative ('significantly impact trading costs'); no numeric cost magnitude or rate relation is defined, so the effect is carried as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric inequality.

limitations: Only the selected potential impact on legitimate market makers' trading costs is formalized; other impacts (blocking POST_ONLY, forced GTC taker execution, unfair advantage) are handled in separate passes.
The impact is potential, so the relation asserts absence of the increased-cost outcome only under the stated scenario, not an inevitable effect.
Fee percentages 0.03% and 0.05% are bound as percent-unit integers from the intent statement; the impact statement itself gives no numeric magnitude.
